title: Types of Volcanoes
subject: Geography
description: This diagram classifies different types of volcanoes based on their structure, eruption characteristics, and formation, providing key examples for each.
mermaidCode:
graph TD
A[Types of Volcanoes] --> B[Shield Volcanoes]
B --> B1(Broad, gently sloping cones)
B --> B2(Low-viscosity basaltic lava)
B --> B3(Non-explosive eruptions)
B3 --> B4(Mauna Loa, Kilauea)
A --> C[Composite (Stratovolcanoes)]
C --> C1(Steep-profile cones)
C --> C2(Alternating lava flows & tephra)
C --> C3(Explosive eruptions)
C3 --> C4(Mt. Fuji, Mt. Vesuvius, Mt. St. Helens)
A --> D[Calderas]
D --> D1(Large depressions)
D --> D2(Formed by collapse after massive eruption)
D2 --> D3(Crater Lake, Santorini)
A --> E[Flood Basalt Provinces]
E --> E1(Vast plateaus)
E --> E2(Successive basaltic flows from fissure eruptions)
E2 --> E3(Deccan Traps, Columbia River Basalts)
A --> F[Mid-Ocean Ridge Volcanoes]
F --> F1(Underwater volcanoes)
F --> F2(Divergent boundaries)
F2 --> F3(Continuous basaltic eruptions)
F3 --> F4(Mid-Atlantic Ridge)
